Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020. These picks span a range of styles—from gritty neo‑noir to high‑stakes heist dramas—and have earned praise from critics and audiences alike.

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling, time‑juggling saga that blends crime history with Scorsese’s signature storytelling. |
| 2 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II | A courtroom thriller that doubles as a political drama, with razor‑sharp dialogue. |
| 3 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Hugh Grant | Ritchie’s fast‑paced, witty take on the British gangster world. |
| 4 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A tense psychological thriller about a man falsely accused of a crime. |
| 5 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern twist on the classic horror‑thriller, blending crime investigation with psychological terror. |
| 6 | **The Nightingale** | Jennifer Kent | Lily James, David Wenham | A gritty, revenge‑driven crime story set in 19th‑century Australia. |
| 7 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑thriller that examines truth, justice, and gender dynamics. |
| 8 | **The Little Things** | John Lee Hancock | Denzel Washington, Rami Malek, Jared Leto | A noir‑inspired detective story with a dark, atmospheric tone. |
| 9 | **The Devil All the Time** | Antonio Campos | Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, Ethan Hawke | A bleak, character‑driven crime drama that explores violence and morality. |
|10 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson‑Cohen | A modern take on the classic horror‑thriller, blending crime investigation with psychological terror. |

### How to Watch

- **Streaming**: Many of these titles are available on platforms like Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or HBO Max. Check your local listings or use a service like JustWatch to find where each film is streaming.
- **Physical Media**: If you prefer Blu‑ray or DVD, most of these films have been released on physical media and can be purchased from retailers or rented from libraries.

Enjoy diving into some of the most compelling crime‑thrillers of 2020!
